# create reusable transform: identify horizontal/vertical grid lines from most frequent divider colors, return tile interiors and marker overlays
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # divider rows/columns are those uniformly dominated by a single color
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))<=2 and sum(v!=grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])<=2]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})<=2 and sum(grid[r][c]!=grid[0][c] for r in range(h))<=2]
    # use detected repeated full grid lines
    if not rows: rows=[0]
    if not cols: cols=[0]
    # cell regions between divider lines, sample center
    rb=[-1]+rows+[h]; cb=[-1]+cols+[w]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        rr=(rb[i]+rb[i+1])//2
        line=[]
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            cc=(cb[j]+cb[j+1])//2
            val=grid[rr][cc]
            # overlay marker found at upper-left grid intersection
            ar=rb[i+1]; ac=cb[j+1]
            if ar<h and ac<w and grid[ar][ac] not in (grid[rr][cc],): val=grid[ar][ac]
            line.append(val)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
